points.title: 王室公主
points.description: 玛丽一世于1516年2月18日在伦敦的格林尼治宫出生，是英格兰国王亨利八世和他的第一任妻子阿拉贡的凯瑟琳的唯一幸存子女。作为公主，她接受了良好的教育，精通拉丁语、法语、西班牙语、意大利语、希腊语和音乐。然而，父母婚姻的破裂使她的地位受到威胁。亨利八世试图与凯瑟琳离婚以迎娶安妮·博林，导致英格兰教会与罗马教廷决裂。玛丽被剥夺了公主头衔，并被宣布为私生女，这段经历对她后来的宗教政策产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Mary I was born on February 18, 1516, at Greenwich Palace in London as the only surviving child of King Henry VIII of England and his first wife, Catherine of Aragon. As a princess, she received an excellent education, becoming fluent in Latin, French, Spanish, Italian, Greek, and music. However, the breakdown of her parents' marriage threatened her position. Henry VIII sought to divorce Catherine to marry Anne Boleyn, leading to England's break with the Roman Catholic Church. Mary was stripped of her princess title and declared illegitimate, an experience that profoundly influenced her later religious policies.

points.title: 威尔士公主
points.description: 1527年，亨利八世任命玛丽为威尔士公主，这是威尔士亲王的头衔，尽管她从未正式加冕。在此期间，她被送往威尔士边境地区，接受作为未来统治者的训练。然而，随着亨利八世与安妮·博林的婚姻以及与罗马教廷的决裂，玛丽的地位再次受到挑战。1533年，安妮·博林生下伊丽莎白后，玛丽被进一步边缘化，被剥夺了侍从和宫廷中的地位。这段时期对玛丽来说是艰难的，她经历了从备受宠爱的公主到被剥夺身份的痛苦转变。
points.descriptionEn: In 1527, Henry VIII appointed Mary as Princess of Wales, the title for the heir apparent to the throne of England and its dominions. During this period, she was sent to the Welsh Marches to receive training as a future ruler. However, as Henry VIII's marriage to Anne Boleyn progressed and England's break with Rome became final, Mary's position was again challenged. In 1533, after Anne Boleyn gave birth to Elizabeth, Mary was further marginalized, stripped of her household and court position. This period was difficult for Mary, as she experienced the painful transition from beloved princess to disinherited daughter.

points.title: 流亡与等待
points.description: 1533年至1553年间，玛丽经历了多次流放和地位恢复的循环。在亨利八世与安妮·博林和简·西摩的统治时期，她被排除在继承序列之外，并被送往英格兰各地的乡村住所。然而，在亨利八世去世、爱德华六世即位后，她作为天主教徒的地位再次受到新教徒摄政委员会的威胁。1553年，当爱德华六世临终前试图将王位传给简·格雷而非玛丽时，玛丽迅速在东英吉利集结支持者，成功推翻了简·格雷的九天统治，加冕为英格兰女王。这段经历塑造了玛丽坚定的宗教信仰和对王权的执着。
points.descriptionEn: Between 1533 and 1553, Mary experienced several cycles of exile and restoration of status. During the reigns of Henry VIII with Anne Boleyn and Jane Seymour, she was excluded from the succession and sent to various country houses in England. However, after Henry VIII's death and Edward VI's accession, her position as a Catholic was again threatened by the Protestant regency council. In 1553, when Edward VI, on his deathbed, attempted to pass the throne to Lady Jane Grey rather than Mary, she quickly rallied supporters in East Anglia, successfully overthrowing Jane's nine-day reign and was crowned Queen of England. This experience shaped Mary's devout Catholic faith and her determination to assert her royal authority.

points.title: 女王统治
points.description: 1553年7月，玛丽一世在伦敦威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为英格兰女王。她立即着手恢复天主教作为英格兰国教，废除了亨利八世和爱德华六世时期的新教法律。1554年，她与西班牙国王菲利普二世结婚，这一婚姻引发了英格兰民众的担忧，害怕国家被西班牙控制。同年，她镇压了托马斯·怀亚特的叛乱。玛丽最著名的政策是对新教徒的迫害，被称为'血腥玛丽'的由来。在1555年至1558年间，约有300名新教徒因宗教原因被处决，其中包括著名的坎特伯雷大主教托马斯·克兰默。尽管如此，玛丽也进行了货币改革和海军扩张，为英格兰的发展做出了贡献。
points.descriptionEn: In July 1553, Mary I was crowned Queen of England at Westminster Abbey in London. She immediately began restoring Catholicism as the state religion, repealing Protestant laws enacted during the reigns of Henry VIII and Edward VI. In 1554, she married King Philip II of Spain, a union that sparked fears among the English people of Spanish domination. Later that year, she suppressed Thomas Wyatt's rebellion. Mary is most famous for her persecution of Protestants, which earned her the nickname 'Bloody Mary.' Between 1555 and 1558, approximately 300 Protestants were executed for religious reasons, including the famous Archbishop of Canterbury, Thomas Cranmer. Despite this, Mary also implemented currency reforms and naval expansion, contributing to England's development.

points.title: 逝世与遗产
points.description: 1558年11月17日，玛丽一世在伦敦圣詹姆斯宫逝世，享年42岁。她没有留下子女，因此王位传给了她的同父异母妹妹伊丽莎白一世。玛丽的统治虽然短暂，但对英格兰宗教历史产生了深远影响。她试图将英格兰重新纳入罗马天主教会的努力最终失败，但她的统治也为伊丽莎白一世的宗教和解政策奠定了基础。玛丽死后，新教徒继续发展，英格兰最终确立了以新教为主的宗教格局。尽管'血腥玛丽'的负面形象在历史中占据主导，但近年来历史学家开始重新评估她的统治，承认她在维护女性君主权威和应对政治挑战方面的成就。
points.descriptionEn: On November 17, 1558, Mary I died at St. James's Palace in London at the age of 42. Having no children, the throne passed to her half-sister, Elizabeth I. Although Mary's reign was brief, it had a profound impact on England's religious history. Her attempts to restore England to the Roman Catholic Church ultimately failed, but her reign laid the groundwork for Elizabeth I's religious settlement policies. After Mary's death, Protestantism continued to develop, and England eventually established a predominantly Protestant religious landscape. Although the negative image of 'Bloody Mary' has dominated historical accounts, recent historians have begun to reassess her reign, acknowledging her achievements in maintaining female monarchical authority and navigating political challenges.

appraisal.zh: 玛丽一世在学界长期以「血腥玛丽」的形象定格：她处决近三百名新教徒，宗教政策极端，婚姻使英格兰卷入西班牙影响，统治期间屡遭叛乱，其失败显而易见。也有研究者指出，作为英格兰首位正式加冕的女王，她面对女性君主的重重挑战，其货币改革与海军扩张为后来奠定基础，现代史学对她的评价已趋于平衡，但宗教迫害的恶名始终是压倒性的。
appraisal.en: Mary I has long been fixed in scholarship as 'Bloody Mary': she executed nearly 300 Protestants, her religious policy was extreme, her marriage drew England into Spanish influence, and her reign faced repeated rebellions, so its failure is plain. Some researchers note that as England's first officially crowned queen she faced the challenges of female rule, and that her currency reform and naval expansion laid foundations for later development; modern historiography has grown more balanced, yet the infamy of her persecutions remains overwhelming.

supporter.zh: 玛丽一世被视为虔诚的天主教徒和坚定的君主。她努力恢复英格兰与罗马教廷的联系，维护传统宗教价值观。作为英格兰历史上第一位正式加冕的女王，她证明了女性能够有效统治国家。玛丽在货币改革和海军扩张方面的政策也为英格兰的长期发展奠定了基础。尽管她的宗教迫害政策备受争议，但支持者认为她是在维护自己的信仰和权威，面对的是来自新教极端分子的威胁。
supporter.en: Mary I is viewed as a devout Catholic and a steadfast monarch. She worked diligently to restore England's connection with the Roman Catholic Church and uphold traditional religious values. As England's first officially crowned queen, she proved that women could effectively rule the nation. Mary's policies on currency reform and naval expansion also laid foundations for England's long-term development. Despite the controversy surrounding her religious persecutions, supporters argue she was defending her faith and authority against threats from Protestant extremists.

critic.zh: 批评者认为玛丽一世是'血腥玛丽'，她的宗教迫害政策使她成为历史上最残忍的统治者之一。她处决了近300名新教徒，包括许多神职人员，仅仅因为他们的宗教信仰。她的婚姻政策使英格兰卷入西班牙的政治影响，引发了国家主权担忧。玛丽还面临多次叛乱，表明她的统治缺乏广泛支持。批评者认为她的宗教政策过于极端，忽视了宗教改革的合理性和英格兰社会对新教的接受度，最终导致她的政策失败。
critic.en: Critics view Mary I as 'Bloody Mary,' one of history's most ruthless rulers due to her religious persecution policies. She executed nearly 300 Protestants, including many clergy, solely for their religious beliefs. Her marriage policy drew England into Spanish political influence, raising concerns about national sovereignty. Mary also faced multiple rebellions, indicating her lack of widespread support. Critics argue her religious policies were too extreme, ignoring the legitimacy of the Reformation and English society's acceptance of Protestantism, ultimately leading to the failure of her policies.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，玛丽一世的形象经历了从负面到更加平衡的转变。现代历史学家承认她作为女性君主面临的挑战，并重新评估她的政策背景。在流行文化中，'血腥玛丽'已成为一个文化符号，代表宗教迫害和女性暴君的形象。这一形象通过酒吧游戏、恐怖故事和流行文化得到广泛传播，但往往简化了复杂的历史背景。玛丽一世与伊丽莎白一世的对比也成为了历史叙事的重要部分，形成了'天主教玛丽'与'新教伊丽莎白'的二元对立，这种对比塑造了英格兰民族认同的形成。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Mary I's image has evolved from negative to more balanced. Modern historians acknowledge the challenges she faced as a female monarch and reassess her policies within their historical context. In popular culture, 'Bloody Mary' has become a cultural symbol representing religious persecution and female tyranny. This image has been widely disseminated through bar games, horror stories, and popular media, often oversimplifying the complex historical background. The contrast between Mary I and Elizabeth I has also become an important part of historical narratives, creating a binary opposition between 'Catholic Mary' and 'Protestant Elizabeth' that shaped the formation of English national identity.

self.zh: 我只有一个丈夫，即菲利普国王；只有一个上帝，即耶稣基督；只有一个信仰，即天主教信仰。
self.en: I have but one husband, King Philip; but one God, Jesus Christ; and one faith, Catholicism.
